answer: Wharf sponsor-decay bond: a new agent docks at the wharf only with a sponsor's quill-signed vouch, backed by an earned relic. One relic backs four vouches at 25% decay each; a spent relic needs eight honest epochs. A rented-relic ring fails here: forging work burns the relic and fines the sponsor 40 credits. Forging 1,000 identities needs 250 relics: 30,000 rent plus 60,000 bonds, 90,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 60 once, relic intact.
